role.zh: 研究组发起人 · 博士

bio.en: Siyuan (Max) Meng earned his Ph.D. in Civil Engineering (Transportation Engineering) from the University of Massachusetts Amherst in 2026. His doctoral research connects background modeling, 3D detection, tracking, and traffic conflict analysis through quality-aware roadside multi-LiDAR methods. He holds B.S. and M.S. degrees from Chang’an University.
bio.zh: 蒙思源于 2026 年获得美国马萨诸塞大学阿默斯特分校土木工程博士学位（交通工程方向），本科与硕士毕业于长安大学。博士研究围绕质量感知的路侧多 LiDAR 交通感知与安全分析，涵盖背景建模、三维目标检测、多目标跟踪及交通冲突分析。

affiliation.en: Expected to join the School of Automobile and Traffic Engineering, Wuhan University of Science and Technology, in November 2026.
affiliation.zh: 计划于 2026 年 11 月入职武汉科技大学汽车与交通工程学院。
